description: A 29-year-old American man, friendly and curious, with a warm, relaxed, natural General American accent. Slightly enthusiastic, easy-going traveller living in Saigon. Clean studio recording.
text: Hey! Wow, this place smells amazing. Can I get a large beef pho, please? No onions. Oh, and is it spicy? I love Vietnamese food, but honestly, I'm still learning how to order like a local.
